edit_request_items_kind_shape_check.name: edit_request_items_kind_shape_check
edit_request_items_kind_shape_check.value: ("edit_request_items"."kind" = 'suggestion' and "edit_request_items"."replacement_md" is not null and "edit_request_items"."note_body" is null and "edit_request_items"."status" <> 'resolved') or ("edit_request_items"."kind" = 'note' and "edit_request_items"."replacement_md" is null and "edit_request_items"."reason" is null and "edit_request_items"."accepted_version_id" is null and "edit_request_items"."note_body" is not null and btrim("edit_request_items"."note_body") <> '' and "edit_request_items"."status" not in ('accepted', 'rejected'))

pages_trash_root_idx.name: pages_trash_root_idx
pages_trash_root_idx.where: "pages"."deleted_at" is not null and "pages"."purged_at" is null
